falsification_conditions.condition: BTC/USD closes below $58,000 on any daily candle
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A decisive breakdown below the key support level would invalidate the HOLD signal and the 2019-style mini-top pattern, indicating the blowoff phase has already completed and a deeper correction is underway.

falsification_conditions.condition: Total crypto market cap drops below $2.1 trillion while BTC dominance rises above 55%
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: This would show capital rotating out of altcoins into BTC as a safe haven, contradicting the blowoff score of 56 which implies speculative altcoin strength is still building toward a final top.

falsification_conditions.condition: Funding rates on major perp exchanges (Binance, Bybit, OKX) turn negative for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Persistent negative funding would signal that leveraged longs have already been flushed out and bearish sentiment dominates, invalidating the pattern match to June 2019 where funding remained positive into the local top.

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
